description: Katja Klinar, Izak Oberčkal Pluško and Andrej Kitanovski at the University of Ljubljana publish DisCoNetHeat through the 3DIVERSE project. The application maps potential district-heating disconnections using coordinates and levelised-cost-of-heat categories supplied in an Excel file. QGIS maps highlight places where district heating costs more than individual heating, allowing comparison of alternative cost scenarios. Zenodo supplies the January 2025 code archive free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the network defined by the user; the metadata do not specify a fixed geography, planning period or numerical prediction accuracy. Relative costs indicate possible disconnection incentives, not observed household choices. The tool can prepare spatial assumptions for network-viability and demand-loss simulations. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. Runtime versions and the actual archive contents were not checked.
